pose: Full side profile of a sturdy Chasmosaurus. It has a large, rectangular-shaped frill with prominent spikes along the edges. The body is rendered with high-fidelity leathery skin, focusing on the wide, heavy torso and powerful legs. Spine and tail are held perfectly horizontal. Soulful eyes and a closed-mouth smirk. Massive negative space buffers above and below the character to ensure the frill isn't clipped in a 17:7 aspect ratio.
